items.source: Returns the underlying revision metadata which might provider more detailed implementation specific information.
items.translation: 返回底层修订元数据，该元数据可能提供更为详细的实现特定信息。

items.source: Returns the time stamp of the revision, immediately failing on absence.
items.translation: 返回修订的时间戳，若不存在则立即失败。

items.source: Returns the revision number of the revision, immediately failing on absence.
items.translation: 返回修订号的版本号，若不存在则立即失败。
